en.Situation: In my first pre-sales role, a client demo was booked for Monday and the demo environment still had last quarter's data.
en.Task: I had to make the demo believable without claiming it was their live system.
en.Action: I reloaded the sample data, wrote three talking points per screen, and ran the demo twice with a colleague asking hard questions.
en.Result: The demo ran without a hiccup, and the client asked for a follow-up workshop on two of the screens.
en.vague: There was a demo to prepare and the data was old.
en.exaggerated: I closed the deal during the demo by myself.
en.no_data: The demo went fine and the client was interested.

zh.Situation: 第一份售前工作，星期一有客戶 demo，而 demo 環境仲係上一季嘅數據。
zh.Task: 我要令 demo 可信，但唔可以講成係佢哋嘅正式系統。
zh.Action: 我重載樣本數據，為每個畫面寫三個講點，再同同事預演兩次並由佢問難題。
zh.Result: demo 順利，客戶要求就其中兩個畫面開跟進工作坊。
zh.vague: 有個 demo 要準備，數據又舊。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人喺 demo 期間成交咗。

en.Situation: An RFP asked for twenty technical requirements in nine days, and six of them needed an answer from the engineering team.
en.Task: I owned the technical section, and I had to get those six answers without overpromising.
en.Action: I marked each requirement as supported, partly, or not today, sent the six questions in one batch, and left the weak answers visible.
en.Result: The submission went in on time with three honest gaps, and the client asked about exactly those three in the first call.
en.vague: There was an RFP and the deadline was tight.
en.exaggerated: I wrote the winning bid single-handedly.
en.no_data: We submitted on time and the client called us.

zh.Situation: 一份 RFP 有二十項技術要求，九日內要交，而其中六項要工程團隊回答。
zh.Task: 我負責技術部分，要拿到嗰六個答案，但唔可以過度承諾。
zh.Action: 我把每項標為支援、部分支援或暫時唔支援，一次過把六條問題交去工程，並保留弱項在文件內。
zh.Result: 準時提交，三個缺口如實寫明，客戶第一次通話就問正嗰三項。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人寫咗中標方案。
zh.no_data: 我哋準時提交，客戶有聯絡我哋。

en.Situation: In a client workshop, three departments described three different approval flows and the sales colleague wanted to quote the same day.
en.Task: I had to stop the quote until one flow was agreed, and keep the client comfortable.
en.Action: I drew all three flows, marked the two steps that differed, and proposed agreeing those two before pricing anything.
en.Result: The client agreed the two steps in twenty minutes, and the quote went out a day later without a change request.
en.vague: The client had different ideas about the approval flow.
en.exaggerated: I designed the client's entire process in one workshop.
en.no_data: In the end the quote went out after the workshop.

zh.Situation: 客戶工作坊入面，三個部門講咗三個唔同審批流程，而銷售同事想當日報價。
zh.Task: 我要拖住報價直到議定一個流程，同時令客戶舒服。
zh.Action: 我畫出三個流程，標出兩個有差異嘅步驟，建議先議定該兩步再定價。
zh.Result: 客戶二十分鐘內議定兩步，報價遲一日出，亦冇 change request。
zh.vague: 客戶對審批流程有唔同睇法。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個工作坊就設計好客戶成個流程。
zh.no_data: 最後工作坊之後報價出咗。

en.Situation: Four years in, a proof of concept ran for three weeks and the client's data could not answer two of the agreed questions.
en.Task: I had to report the POC honestly, and still give the client a path forward.
en.Action: I wrote what the POC proved, what the data could not support, and two options with cost and risk for each.
en.Result: The client chose the smaller option, and the delivery team started with a realistic scope instead of a promise.
en.vague: The proof of concept did not fully work.
en.exaggerated: I turned a failing POC into a signed contract.
en.no_data: The client chose a smaller scope and we went ahead.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，一個 POC 做咗三星期，而客戶數據答唔到兩個已議定問題。
zh.Task: 我要老實報告 POC 結果，同時仍然畀客戶一條路。
zh.Action: 我寫明 POC 證明咗咩、數據支持唔到咩，再提出兩個方案各自成本同風險。
zh.Result: 客戶揀較細方案，交付團隊由現實範圍開始而唔係由承諾開始。
zh.exaggerated: 我把一個失敗 POC 變成簽約。
zh.no_data: 客戶揀咗較細範圍，我哋照做。

en.Situation: In a demo, a client's IT manager asked whether our software would work with a system we had never tested against.
en.Task: I had to answer in front of eight people without guessing.
en.Action: I said we had not tested it, described the two integration options we use, and offered a short technical call with our engineer.
en.Result: The call happened the next day, and the answer we gave was one the client could verify in their own test.
en.vague: Someone asked a technical question I did not know.
en.exaggerated: I handled a hostile question and won the room.
en.no_data: We followed up with a technical call.

zh.Situation: demo 期間，客戶 IT 經理問我們軟件會唔會同一個我哋從未測過嘅系統協作。
zh.Task: 我要喺八個人面前答，但唔可以估。
zh.Action: 我講明未測過，介紹我哋用嘅兩種整合方式，並提出同我方工程師開個技術通話。
zh.Result: 通話第二日進行，我哋畀嘅答案客戶可以喺自己環境驗證。
zh.vague: 有人問咗個我唔識嘅技術問題。
zh.exaggerated: 我處理咗一個敵意問題並贏得全場。
zh.no_data: 我哋跟進開咗技術通話。

en.Situation: A client asked for a dashboard with six custom reports in a two-week scope, and our delivery estimate was six weeks.
en.Task: I had to bring the scope down without losing the reason they wanted it.
en.Action: I asked what decision each report supported, found three were for the same weekly meeting, and proposed one combined view.
en.Result: The scope went to two reports and three weeks, and the first version answered the weekly meeting from day one.
en.vague: The client wanted more than we could deliver in the time.
en.exaggerated: I cut the project scope in half and saved the deal.
en.no_data: In the end we agreed a smaller scope.

zh.Situation: 客戶要一個 dashboard 有六份自訂報表，範圍兩星期，而我們交付估算係六星期。
zh.Task: 我要收窄範圍，但唔可以失去佢哋原本嘅目的。
zh.Action: 我問每份報表支持咩決定，發現三份都係為同一個每週會議，於是建議合成一個視圖。
zh.Result: 範圍變成兩份報表三星期，第一版由第一日已答到每週會議需要。
zh.vague: 客戶想要嘅嘢超過我哋時間做得到。
zh.exaggerated: 我把項目範圍減半，救返單生意。

en.Situation: Five years in, the sales team had promised a client an integration that would need four months of work, in a two-month window.
en.Task: I had to correct the promise without making the sales lead look bad in front of the client.
en.Action: I met the sales lead first, agreed the accurate description, and then presented it together as a phased plan.
en.Result: The client accepted the phased plan, and the first phase delivered the part they needed most.
en.vague: There was a promise that did not match the timeline.
en.exaggerated: I stopped the company from breaching a contract.
en.no_data: In the end the plan was changed and the client accepted.

zh.Situation: 做咗五年，銷售團隊向客戶承諾一個要四個月工作嘅整合，但只有兩個月窗口。
zh.Task: 我要修正承諾，但唔想令銷售 lead 喺客戶面前難做。
zh.Action: 我先單獨見銷售 lead，議定準確講法，再一齊以分階段計劃向客戶簡報。
zh.Result: 客戶接受分階段計劃，第一階段交付佢哋最需要嘅部分。
zh.vague: 有個承諾同時間表唔對。
zh.no_data: 最後計劃調整，客戶接受。

en.Situation: In my internship, I was asked to prepare a demo of an API feature for a client who had never seen a technical diagram.
en.Task: I had to explain it at their level and still be accurate.
en.Action: I drew the request and response as two boxes, used their own order process as the example, and checked the wording with an engineer.
en.Result: The client described the flow back to us correctly, and the engineer confirmed nothing was misstated.
en.vague: I had to explain something technical to a non-technical client.
en.exaggerated: I made a complex API simple enough for anyone to understand.

zh.Situation: 實習時要為一位從未睇過技術圖嘅客戶準備 API 功能 demo。
zh.Task: 我要用佢嘅水平解釋，同時保持準確。
zh.Action: 我把 request 同 response 畫成兩個方框，用佢哋自己嘅訂單流程做例子，再同工程師核對講法。
zh.Result: 客戶可以正確講返個流程，工程師亦確認冇講錯。
zh.vague: 我要向非技術客戶解釋技術嘢。
zh.exaggerated: 我令複雜 API 變成任何人都明。

en.Situation: A handover to delivery was scheduled for one hour, and the delivery lead could not attend at the last minute.
en.Task: I had to hand over without losing what the client had been told.
en.Action: I wrote a two-page summary with the promises, the open questions and the client's own words, and sent it before the call.
en.Result: The delivery lead confirmed every point by email, and the client heard nothing different in the kick-off.
en.vague: The handover call did not have everyone in it.
en.exaggerated: I created the team's whole handover process.
en.no_data: In the end the handover worked out.

zh.Situation: 交付交接原定一小時，而交付 lead 臨時嚟唔到。
zh.Task: 我要交接，但唔可以漏咗客戶聽過嘅承諾。
zh.Action: 我寫兩頁摘要，列明承諾、未解決問題同客戶原話，通話前已發出。
zh.Result: 交付 lead 用電郵逐點確認，kick-off 時客戶聽唔到任何唔同嘅講法。
zh.exaggerated: 我建立咗團隊成個交接流程。

en.Situation: Six years in, a client wanted a single sign-on integration priced before their security team had approved the protocol.
en.Task: I had to price it without making the number a commitment to something unapproved.
en.Action: I gave a range with the assumption stated in one line, and marked the two decisions that would move the range.
en.Result: Security chose the protocol we assumed, and the final quote landed inside the range.
en.vague: We had to quote for something that was not fully decided.
en.exaggerated: I predicted the client's security decision exactly.
en.no_data: In the end the quote was close to what we gave.

zh.Situation: 做咗六年，客戶想喺佢哋安全團隊批出協議之前，就先為 single sign-on 整合定價。
zh.Task: 我要報價，但唔可以令個數字變成對未批事項嘅承諾。
zh.Action: 我畀一個範圍，一行寫明假設，並標出會令範圍移動嘅兩個決定。
zh.Result: 安全團隊揀咗我哋假設嘅協議，最終報價落喺範圍之內。
zh.vague: 要為未完全決定嘅事報價。
zh.exaggerated: 我準確預測客戶嘅安全決定。
zh.no_data: 最後報價同我哋畀嘅接近。

en.Situation: On a six-month contract, I joined demos where the same three questions came up every time and nobody had written the answers down.
en.Task: I wanted the answers ready before the next demo, without guessing at them.
en.Action: I collected the three questions, asked the engineer for short answers, and put them on one page the whole team could use.
en.Result: The next demo spent its time on the client's process instead of on the same basics.
en.vague: The same questions came up in demos.
en.exaggerated: I wrote the team's complete technical FAQ.
en.no_data: After the page existed, demos went more smoothly.

zh.Situation: 做半年合約，我參與嘅 demo 每次都有同樣三條問題，而冇人寫低答案。
zh.Task: 我想下次 demo 前有答案，但唔可以自己估。
zh.Action: 我收集三條問題，請工程師畀簡短答案，再寫成一頁全隊都用得。
zh.Result: 下次 demo 嘅時間用喺客戶流程上，而唔係重複基本問題。
zh.vague: demo 每次都有同樣問題。
zh.exaggerated: 我寫咗團隊完整嘅技術 FAQ。
zh.no_data: 有咗嗰頁之後 demo 順好多。

en.Situation: A client's IT team wanted our software to run inside their network, and our product only supported the hosted option.
en.Task: I had to say no clearly and still find a way to move the deal forward.
en.Action: I confirmed the constraint with the engineer, then proposed our API with their own internal front end as an option.
en.Result: The client accepted the API option, and the deal moved to a technical review the following week.
en.vague: The client wanted something we did not offer.
en.exaggerated: I invented a new product line to close the deal.
en.no_data: In the end we found another option they accepted.

zh.Situation: 客戶 IT 團隊想我們軟件喺佢哋網絡內部運行，而我哋產品只支援託管方案。
zh.Task: 我要清楚講唔得，同時搵到方法令交易向前行。
zh.Action: 我同工程師確認限制，再提出以我們 API 配佢哋自己內部前端嘅方案。
zh.Result: 客戶接受 API 方案，交易下星期進入技術評審。
zh.vague: 客戶想要我哋冇提供嘅嘢。
zh.exaggerated: 我為成交創造咗一條新產品線。
zh.no_data: 最後搵到另一個佢哋接受嘅方案。
